Worship Service
Sunday, November 1
4:00 p.m. (Doors open at 3:30)
Please join us at our Palm Hill Worship service on Sunday, November 1 at 4 o’clock in the North Club House.
Communion will be served and the Palm Hill Worship Choir, along with Barbara Brubaker on the piano, will fill the hall with music. If you would like to sing with the choir or play an instrument, please contact Mollie at 269-317-6890.
This is a non-denominational service and all are welcome. Our mission is to provide a place for all to connect with God. Our purpose is to Love God, Love People, Reach Up, Reach Out and Reach In.
For information please contact our Worship Team: Claudia Hartz (315) 368-8166, Steve or Maureen Livers (727) 481-8142, Mollie Cardno (269) 317-6890, Bernadette Witkiewicz (585) 749-2348, Bonnie Swanson (716) 870-3208.
